BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has purchased a total of 1,058,457 ordinary shares on 26, 27, 28, and 29 May 2026, as part of its share buyback program. The average price paid per share across these purchases ranged from 268.84 pence to 280.07 pence. Following these transactions, Serco's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 988,410,118, with 14,335,896 shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights, excluding treasury shares, is also 988,410,118. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 29 May 2026 29 May 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares and Total Voting Rights Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 14,335,896 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 29 May 2026 is 988,410,118 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 5 March 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 14,335,896 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
